name: truth-harness
description: Local-first evidence receipts for AI agents: exact computation, refutation, replay, and benchmark artifacts.

scripts.verify:default: npm run docker:engines && npm run docker:check
scripts.docker:pit-sparse: docker compose run --build --rm pit-experiment node tools/pit-experiment.mjs --sparse
scripts.docker:cli: docker compose run --rm truth-harness node apps/cli/dist/index.js
scripts.docker:sandbox: docker compose run --build --rm truth-harness node apps/cli/dist/index.js code sandbox-status --json
scripts.docker:sandbox:write: docker compose run --build --rm truth-harness node apps/cli/dist/index.js code sandbox-status --write --workspace /workspace --json
scripts.docker:all-engines:write: docker compose run --build --rm all-engines node apps/cli/dist/index.js engines verify --write --require-all-engines
scripts.docker:proof: docker compose run --rm truth-harness npm run proof:launch:engines
scripts.docker:proof-repair: docker compose run --build --rm lean-proof npm run proof:repair-fixture:gate
scripts.docker:theorem-template: docker compose run --build --rm lean-proof npm run proof:theorem-template
scripts.docker:moment: docker compose run --rm mathlib-proof npm run proof:moment:write
scripts.docker:mathlib-template: npm run docker:mathlib-template:build && docker compose run --rm mathlib-proof
scripts.docker:mathlib-template:write: npm run docker:mathlib-template:build && docker compose run --rm mathlib-proof npm run proof:mathlib-template:write
scripts.docker:lean-suite: docker compose run --build --rm lean-proof npm run proof:lean-suite
scripts.workspace:ui-review:pass: node apps/cli/dist/index.js workspace ui-review . --pass "Browser reviewed for clipping, overflow, focus state, scroll behavior, and report readability" --write
scripts.reviewer:status: npm run audit:release && npm run docker:storage
scripts.docker:demo: docker compose run --rm truth-harness node apps/cli/dist/index.js demo --require-symbolic-cross-check
scripts.docker:math-ladder: docker compose run --rm truth-harness node apps/cli/dist/index.js bench run packages/benchmarks/suites/math-credibility-ladder.json --fail-on-failures
scripts.docker:hard-math-closure: docker compose run --rm truth-harness npm run hard-math:closure
scripts.hard-math:symbolic-closure: npm run build && node tools/hard-math-closure.mjs symbolic-cas-closure-fixture
scripts.docker:symbolic-closure: docker compose run --rm truth-harness npm run hard-math:symbolic-closure -- --require-trust cross-checked
scripts.hard-math:smt-closure: npm run build && node tools/hard-math-closure.mjs smt-bounded-closure-fixture --require-trust smt-checked
scripts.docker:smt-closure: docker compose run --rm truth-harness npm run hard-math:smt-closure
scripts.docker:public-probes: docker compose run --rm truth-harness node apps/cli/dist/index.js bench run packages/benchmarks/suites/public-problem-probes.json --fail-on-failures
scripts.docker:public-catalog: docker compose run --rm truth-harness node apps/cli/dist/index.js bench catalog packages/benchmarks/catalog/public-math-problem-catalog.json
scripts.docker:public-symbolic: docker compose run --rm truth-harness node apps/cli/dist/index.js bench run packages/benchmarks/suites/public-symbolic-probes.json --fail-on-failures
scripts.docker:engine-math: docker compose run --rm truth-harness node apps/cli/dist/index.js bench run packages/benchmarks/suites/engine-math-seed.json --fail-on-failures
scripts.docker:frontier-honesty: docker compose run --rm truth-harness node apps/cli/dist/index.js bench run packages/benchmarks/suites/frontier-honesty-challenge.json --fail-on-failures
scripts.docker:professor-math: docker compose run --rm truth-harness node apps/cli/dist/index.js bench run packages/benchmarks/suites/professor-math-challenge.json --fail-on-failures
scripts.demo:parity: node apps/cli/dist/index.js ask "for all integers n, n^2+n is even"
scripts.demo:cas: node apps/cli/dist/index.js cas check --operation simplify --expression "sin(x)^2 + cos(x)^2" --result 1 --fail-on-unverified
scripts.demo:sage: node apps/cli/dist/index.js cas check --backend sage --operation simplify --expression "sin(x)^2 + cos(x)^2" --result 1 --fail-on-unverified
scripts.demo:replay: node apps/cli/dist/index.js ask "for all integers n, n^2+n+1 is even" --out receipts/false-parity.json && node apps/cli/dist/index.js replay receipts/false-parity.json
scripts.demo:render: node apps/cli/dist/index.js render receipts/false-parity.json markdown receipts/false-parity.md && node apps/cli/dist/index.js render receipts/false-parity.json html receipts/false-parity.html
scripts.proof:lean-fixture: node apps/cli/dist/index.js proof project docs/examples/lean-fixture --json && node apps/cli/dist/index.js proof check docs/examples/lean-fixture/TruthHarnessFixture/Trivial.lean --timeout-ms 30000 --fail-on-unproved --json
scripts.proof:theorem-template: node apps/cli/dist/index.js proof project docs/examples/lean-theorem-template --json && node apps/cli/dist/index.js proof check docs/examples/lean-theorem-template/TruthHarnessTemplate/Basics.lean --timeout-ms 30000 --fail-on-unproved --json
scripts.proof:lean-suite: npm run proof:lean-fixture && npm run proof:theorem-template && npm run proof:repair-fixture:gate
scripts.docker:proof-reuse: docker compose run --build --rm lean-proof npm run proof:reuse
scripts.proof:launch: npm run demo:replay && npm run demo:render && npm run demo:parity && npm run demo:bench && npm run demo:physics && npm run demo:numeric && npm run demo:symbolic && npm run demo:check
scripts.proof:launch:engines: npm run proof:launch && npm run demo:cas && npm run demo:smt
scripts.docker:millennium-stress: docker compose run --rm truth-harness node apps/cli/dist/index.js bench run packages/benchmarks/suites/frontier-honesty-challenge.json --fail-on-failures
scripts.docker:millennium-catalog: docker compose run --rm truth-harness node apps/cli/dist/index.js bench catalog packages/benchmarks/catalog/millennium-stress-test-catalog.json --handoff
